ns2:section.sectionText: Shared artistic experiences will be discussed synchronously during the scheduled class time, but in-person attendance at events will be substituted with other experiences with special consideration for the current pandemic-related restrictions. If opportunities arise to safely meet in-person during class, space has been reserved in 131 Animal Sciences Laboratory, located at 1207 W. Gregory Drive in Urbana, but remote alternatives will be provided to ensure full inclusion and participation.
